question: Down payment kitna hota hai?
answer: Ye property se property vary karta hai, generally 20% se 50% tak. Poori detail property ki payment plan mein mil jayegi.

question: Kya installment plan available hai har property par?
answer: Zyadatar under-construction aur naye launch properties par installment plans available hain. Ready-to-move properties par aksar full payment required hoti hai.

question: Installment plan kitne saal ka hota hai?
answer: Zyadatar plans 2 se 4 saal ke tenure mein hote hain, quarterly installments ke saath. Exact tenure property ki payment plan mein confirm ho jata hai.

question: Kya late installment par penalty lagti hai?
answer: Ye policy developer se developer alag hoti hai. Ye detail mere paas abhi nahi hai, mein confirm kar ke aap ko bata deta hoon.

question: Kya property clear title hai?
answer: Sab humari listings verified aur clear title ke saath hoti hain, documentation site visit ke waqt dikhayi jati hai.

question: Kya aap registry aur transfer mein madad karte hain?
answer: Jee haan, humari legal team registry aur transfer ke pure process mein madad karti hai, advisory ke liye koi extra charge nahi hai.

question: Buy karne ke liye kaun se documents chahiye?
answer: CNIC copy aur proof of funds required hoti hai. Overseas Pakistanis ke liye Power of Attorney ke zariye bhi transaction complete ho sakta hai.

question: Kya overseas Pakistani property remotely buy kar sakte hain?
answer: Jee bilkul, Power of Attorney embassy ya consulate se attest kara ke Pakistan mein representative ke through poora process ho jata hai.

question: Property transfer par tax lagta hai kya?
answer: Jee haan, buyer ko withholding tax dena hota hai aur seller ko capital gains tax, rate filer status aur holding period par depend karta hai.

question: Community mein kya amenities available hain?
answer: Har property alag hoti hai — kuch mein security, park, gym, aur club house shamil hain. Exact list property ki detail mein confirm ho jayegi.

question: Kya property mein swimming pool hai?
answer: Ye har listing par depend karta hai. Mein retrieved data check kar ke bata sakta hoon ke is specific property mein pool available hai ya nahi.

question: School aur hospital kitni door hain?
answer: Zyadatar humari listings mein nearby schools aur hospitals ki distance record hoti hai, 1 se 5 kilometer ke andar. Specific property ke liye mein confirm kar deta hoon.

question: Ye area safe hai kya?
answer: Har location ka apna security setup hota hai — gated societies mein aksar 24/7 security available hoti hai. Mein aap ko exact details retrieved data se bata sakta hoon.

question: Kya ye acha investment hai?
answer: Mein guaranteed returns ka wada nahi kar sakta, lekin agar historical price trend data available ho to mein woh aap ko share kar deta hoon.

question: Property ki value future mein barhegi kya?
answer: Ye prediction mere paas nahi hai — hum sirf historical listing data rakhte hain, future price ka andaza nahi laga sakte.

question: Ye builder acha hai?
answer: Kuch developers ka track record hamare paas record hota hai — jaise active projects aur founding year. Specific developer ke baare mein mein confirm kar ke bata deta hoon.

question: Maintenance charges kitne hain?
answer: Ye har society aur property ke hisaab se different hoti hai. Ye detail mere paas abhi nahi hai, mein confirm kar ke aap ko bata deta hoon.

question: Site visit kaise book kar sakte hain?
answer: Jee bilkul, mein aap ke liye convenient din aur time check kar ke visit schedule kar deta hoon.

question: Kya visit cancel ya reschedule ho sakti hai?
answer: Jee haan, koi masla nahi — mein aap ki booking reschedule ya cancel kar sakta hoon, bas mujhe naya time bata dijiye.

question: Aap logo par bharosa kyun karoon?
answer: Ye sawal bilkul jayez hai jab itni bari investment ki baat ho. Humare paas registered properties aur verified listings hain, aur mein aap ko specific details share kar sakta hoon.

question: Kya listed price se kam mein deal ho sakta hai?
answer: Listed price se neeche quote karne ke liye human agent ki approval chahiye hoti hai. Mein ye request aage forward kar sakta hoon.
